message: Not supported: r=0.07 n=390, perm-null; long-SPY rule 54 trades, Sharpe-like -0.31, actionability 1.87 - Iran tone shocks do not predict SPY direction

trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
